name: oneworld (Aloha a puni ka honua)
description: Hawaiian's Pualani scheme on an A330 with its 'HAWAIIAN' title replaced by the oneworld mark: 'member of' over a large 'oneworld' (navy-violet, 'one' heavy, 'world' thin) across the forward windows, and 'Aloha a puni ka hōnua' ('Aloha all around the world', in Hawaiian) in a gray serif beneath it; the silver-gray maile lei draped from the crown behind the second door down across the windows to the belly; magenta hibiscus at the front of the purple aft fuselage; the purple-to-magenta fin with Pualani; a small oneworld roundel behind the cockpit.

sources.title: Alaska Air Group newsroom: 'Aloha all around the world:' Hawaiian Airlines unveils oneworld alliance livery aircraft featuring ʻŌlelo Hawaiʻi (2026-06-30)
sources.note: An A330 keeping the Pualani tail and the maile lei, adding the oneworld mark and 'Aloha a puni ka honua' ('Aloha all around the world'); unveiled 2026-06-30 in Honolulu.

logos.description: Pualani ('flower of the sky'): a Hawaiian woman's face and neck in profile in white, facing forward and a little up with a calm slight smile. Her deep indigo hair is drawn back from the forehead and falls down her back off the trailing edge. A red hibiscus with a dark heart sits behind her ear and runs off the trailing edge too. Mirrored on the right side.
The small oneworld roundel behind the cockpit, under a small Hawaiian flag.

titles.style: Small lowercase geometric sans above the start of 'oneworld', behind the forward door.
The oneworld wordmark: 'one' heavy, across the forward windows from just behind the forward door.
The oneworld wordmark: 'world' thin, straight after 'one', past the second door.

Small lowercase geometric sans above the start of 'oneworld', behind the forward door. Right side not shown in any image: assumed to mirror the left, the wordmark reading normally from its aft end ('one' aft, 'world' forward), as on Alaska's oneworld jets.

The oneworld wordmark: 'one' heavy, across the forward windows from just behind the forward door. Right side not shown in any image: assumed to mirror the left, the wordmark reading normally from its aft end ('one' aft, 'world' forward), as on Alaska's oneworld jets.

The oneworld wordmark: 'world' thin, straight after 'one', past the second door. Right side not shown in any image: assumed to mirror the left, the wordmark reading normally from its aft end ('one' aft, 'world' forward), as on Alaska's oneworld jets.
'Aloha all around the world' in ʻŌlelo Hawaiʻi: an upright serif in gray, mixed case, under the windows beneath 'oneworld' (the kahakō on the o of hōnua).

notes: Measured on the airline's press renderings of N375HA's left side (fitted to the A330-200 shape; the fit is about 1 m off at the nose and tail, near the titles about 0.2 m), checked against the Commons photo of 2026-09-13. The titles' heights and baselines are taken from their places against the windows (the windows run through the middle of 'one'), where the fit was least sure. No image shows the right side: drawn the same as the left (the oneworld wordmark reading normally), unconfirmed. The aft purple, the magenta flowers and the lei are the standard scheme's, measured here on the A330 rather than the A321neo; the fin and Pualani are the standard's. The 'Hawaiian' title is gone on the left; whether a smaller one appears elsewhere isn't shown. How long the jet keeps the paint isn't announced.
history: Hawaiian joined oneworld on 2026-04-22, the day its flights moved to Alaska's AS code; this jet was unveiled on 2026-06-30 at Honolulu. Alaska has its own oneworld 737s (ASA/oneworld).
